# Sci-Hub

> Sci-Hub is an open-access academic research database providing free access to millions of scientific papers across all disciplines, from biomedical sciences to artificial intelligence.

Founded by Alexandra Elbakyan, Sci-Hub democratizes access to peer-reviewed research by removing paywalls that restrict scientific knowledge. The platform serves as a comprehensive paper repository with discovery features, similar article recommendations, and integration with academic indexing systems like Portico.

## Key Topics

- Academic Papers

## Core Platform

- [Sci-Hub Homepage](https://sci-hub.ru): Main portal for accessing open access academic papers and the research database
- [Sci-Hub Documentary](https://sci-hub.ru/movie): 2025 documentary film about Sci-Hub and open access science featuring founder Alexandra Elbakyan

## Research Papers & Discovery

- [Similar Articles Discovery](https://sci-hub.ru/similar/10.1609/aimag.v37i1.2642): Similar articles discovery feature for AI Magazine paper on artificial intelligence
- [Charge Transport through Biomolecular Wires](https://sci-hub.ru/meta/10.1103/physrevlett.102.208102): Research paper on charge transport and biomolecular wires quantum transport
- [Improving Manufacturability of Ibuprofen Powder Blend](https://sci-hub.ru/meta/10.1016/j.powtec.2013.08.031): Pharmaceutical research on ibuprofen powder coating with silica nanoparticles
- [Aid Coordination for Health Sector Reform](https://sci-hub.ru/meta/10.1016/0168-8510(96)00855-x): Health policy paper on aid coordination and institutional reform in low-income countries
- [Cnidarians Reveal Intermediate Stages in Hox Cluster Evolution](https://sci-hub.ru/meta/10.1093/icb/41.3.608): Evolutionary biology research on cnidarian development and Hox cluster evolution

## Life Sciences & Medicine

- [Predictors of Smoking Relapse by Abstinence Duration](https://sci-hub.ru/meta/10.1111/j.1360-0443.2009.02732.x): Tobacco control study on smoking relapse predictors from International Tobacco Control Survey
- [Central Nervous System Circuits Controlling Body Temperature](https://sci-hub.ru/meta/10.1016/j.neulet.2018.11.027): Neuroscience research on thermoregulation and CNS homeostasis mechanisms
- [Expression of IL-3 cDNA in Murine Bone Marrow Cells](https://sci-hub.ru/meta/10.1007/bf02997490): Molecular biology research on interleukin-3 expression and autonomous cell growth
- [Myelosuppressive Effects of Cytosine Arabinoside on Bone Marrow](https://sci-hub.ru/meta/10.1002/stem.5530100109): Hematology study on cytosine arabinoside effects in long-term bone marrow cultures
- [Estresse Ocupacional em Profissionais de Saúde](https://sci-hub.ru/meta/10.1590/s0102-37722009000300004): Portuguese occupational stress study on healthcare professionals and nurse burnout
- [Doramectin Efficacy Against Kidney Worm in Sows](https://sci-hub.ru/meta/10.1016/s0304-4017(96)01000-x): Veterinary research on doramectin anthelmintic efficacy for swine parasitology

## Social Sciences & Environmental Research

- [Unified Framework for School and Neighborhood Preferences](https://sci-hub.ru/meta/10.1086/522381): Econometric analysis of school preferences and residential sorting using Census data
- [Improving Credibility of Candidate Gene Studies in Emotion](https://sci-hub.ru/meta/10.1037/emo0000076): Research methodology review on candidate gene studies and behavioral genetics credibility
- [Road to Food Waste Paved with Good Intentions](https://sci-hub.ru/meta/10.1016/j.resconrec.2019.05.037): Consumer behavior research on household food waste reduction and conflicting goals
- [Impact of Sea Level Rise on Tidal Range in Chesapeake and Delaware Bays](https://sci-hub.ru/meta/10.1002/2016jc012597): Coastal climate research on sea level rise impacts on tidal ranges in US estuaries

## Chemistry & Materials Science

- [Fluorescence Spectra Analysis of PRODAN in Protic Solvents](https://sci-hub.ru/meta/10.1080/00319100701594198): Chemical physics research on PRODAN fluorescence spectroscopy and Gaussian fitting
- [Essential Oil Composition of Juniperus cedrus from Madeira](https://sci-hub.ru/meta/10.1002/ffj.1061): Phytochemistry research on essential oil composition of Madeira juniper species
